cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You and your manager both say my train was cancelled. Who told you to match stories?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The signal failed. It's on the public departure board.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. They've recruited the board operators to stop me reaching the interview.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The same fault is delaying three counties.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three counties to keep me unemployed. My replacement must already have government backing.

mechanism: A treats a railway employee's service information as evidence to be professionally classified in an expanding plot against A's job interview.
confusable: Mere personal paranoia is insufficient; public explanations must become proof of increasingly organized involvement.
comparison: A stranded applicant confronting staff differs from household warranty recovery.
seedUse: Keep cancelled train, board and regional failure; make A supervise testimony rather than announce a standard.
